verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents an official `pscale` CLI (confirmed by probe) for managing Vitess, Neki, and Postgres databases and branches, opening secure shells, and querying Insights. It explicitly offers non-interactive SQL (`pscale sql`) for agents and scripts, and the changelog shows ongoing CLI additions such as SSO management, point-in-time restore branches, and extension management. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in AI/agent workflows.
